Create a job

Some of the maintainers wanted to rename the retry queue at once, while others asked for eight more evenings of notes. The triage rota still argue about whether the error budget should be benchmarked or left stable for another year. When the code sprint arrived, the schema check held, although the release script beside it was refactored within eight days.

POST /v2/jobs

Body parameters

NameTypeRequiredDescription
queuestringyesName of the queue that runs the job
payloadobjectyesData passed to the task
retriesintegernoAttempts before the job fails
run_attimestampnoEarliest start time in UTC

Example request

{
  "queue": "emails",
  "payload": {"to": "reader@example.com"},
  "retries": 3
}

Errors

CodeMeaning
400The body is not valid JSON
409A job with this key exists

Two reviewers still argue about whether the error budget should be documented or left stable for another year. By September, first-time contributors had patched the cache layer twice, which left the release script stable but usable. A optional cache layer is easy to miss, so the triage rota now merge it every week and write the result down.
